fields.Name: T178 - API Key List Column Sort
fields.Description: Exercises the custom toggleSort()/getSortIcon() sort logic in the bespoke API key grid (not AG Grid), a distinct code path from generic grid sorting.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Switch to the Admin application via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, open 'Identity & Access', and select the 'API Keys' sub-section, then reach the full key list ('View All Keys' or a KPI card). The grid header has sortable columns (Key, Owner, Status, Expires, Last Used, Created). Click a sortable column header such as 'Owner' or 'Created', then click it again to reverse. Verify a sort indicator icon appears on that column and the row order changes accordingly (or a valid empty state shows if there are no keys). Seeing the sort indicator and reordering is success. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking a sortable column header (e.g. Owner or Created) shows a sort-direction indicator on that column
Clicking the header again toggles the sort direction (indicator flips) and the row order changes, OR a valid empty state is shown when no keys exist
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
